parameters.query: SELECT id, calendar_id, owner_user_id, last_synced_at FROM calendar_integrations WHERE is_active = true;

WITH existing_activity AS (
  SELECT id FROM activities WHERE google_event_id = $1
),
found_contact AS (
  SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER($6) AND is_archived = false LIMIT 1
),
new_contact AS (
  INSERT INTO contacts (first_name, last_name, email, lead_source, owner_id, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT $7, $8, $6, 'Calendar Booking', $5, now(), now()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_activity)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found_contact)
  RETURNING id
),
resolved_contact AS (
  SELECT id FROM found_contact
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM new_contact
  LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO activities (contact_id, user_id, type, subject, due_at, end_at, google_event_id, created_at)
SELECT rc.id, $5, 'meeting', $2, $3::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz, $1, now()
FROM resolved_contact rc
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_activity)
RETURNING id;
UPDATE calendar_integrations SET last_synced_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1;
